dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Several years ago, a serious clash appears to have occurred between the previous Knave and a certain child at the House of the Hearth — this led to the latter replacing the former.

dialogues.speaker: Chitose
dialogues.text: Of course, this assumes that our captive speaks the truth. Taking a Fatuus's words at face value would be the height of folly.
